remarks: Newly built spacious townhome in the heart of East Norwalk. Beautifully landscaped grounds welcome you. Eat-in-kitchen with large island, stainless appliances, high-end white cabinetry and counters. Cook your favorite meal while friends gather at the island or watch TV in the open family room with fireplace. Serve dinner in your comfortable dining room open to the balcony. Upstairs, there's a luxurious primary suite with ample closets and modern bath. The other two bedrooms are both en-suite with luxurious baths as well. There's a two-car garage that enters the home through the basement. Set at the end of a quiet road in a convenient location. Walk home from the train and relax in no time. You will love living here.
